title: The recursive option of fs.rmdir has been removed
summary: Node.js removed the recursive option of fs.rmdir() and fs.rmdirSync() (DEP0147: documentation-only since v14.14.0, runtime since v16.0.0, end-of-life since v25.0.0).

constraints: Keep the behavior of the call unchanged; check the replacement's argument and error handling differences.

steps.title: Use fs.rm
steps.instructions: Replace fs.rmdir(path, { recursive: true }) with fs.rm(path, { recursive: true, force: true }), and the sync form with fs.rmSync.

verification.purpose: Run the repository tests when defined.
